## Prioritize the gaps

Review critical and moderate gaps with process owners. Confirm the values, units, and direction of improvement before selecting work to address them.

Keep `gap-analysis.csv` in `output/`. It contains the joined metrics, manual overrides, custom metrics, and timestamps needed by the Kaizen Experiments workspace.

::: {.callout-note}
If a source value is incorrect, update and re-export the Current or Future State metadata before repeating the comparison.

:::
